greed.description: More risk, more reward, more shiny things.
greed.name: Greed

greed-t1-high-stakes.description: A bomb-click still triggers its penalty, but first cashes out your combo: 2x a regular target's score at your current multiplier. Your combo then resets.
greed-t1-high-stakes.name: High Stakes

greed-t1-reckless.description: Clicking a bomb no longer resets your combo.
greed-t1-reckless.name: Reckless

greed-t2-bomb-bounty.description: 5% chance an expiring bomb drops currency.
greed-t2-bomb-bounty.name: Bomb Bounty

greed-t2-double-drops.description: 10% chance a target spawns as a 2× score variant.
greed-t2-double-drops.name: Double Drops

greed-t3-coin-combo.description: While at combo 50+, every hit awards 2 currency.
greed-t3-coin-combo.name: Coin Combo

greed-t3-combo-climb.description: Combo multiplier caps at ×8 instead of ×5.
greed-t3-combo-climb.name: Combo Climb

greed-t4-frenzy.description: Ultimate: 8 seconds where every hit spawns 2 extras nearby and score is ×2.
greed-t4-frenzy.name: Frenzy

mutation.description: Distort the rules. Every perk gives both a cost and a reward - skill decides which dominates.
mutation.name: Mutation

mutation-t1-beacon-bombs.description: Bombs grow to 150% over their lifetime instead of blinking. More visible, more space.
mutation-t1-beacon-bombs.name: Beacon Bombs

mutation-t1-convergent.description: All targets drift toward screen center at ~30 px/s. Tighter cluster - bombs too.
mutation-t1-convergent.name: Convergent

mutation-t1-slow-bloom.description: Targets grow for their first 0.5 s, then shrink. Bigger early window, different rhythm.
mutation-t1-slow-bloom.name: Slow Bloom

mutation-t2-echo.description: Every hit leaves an 800 ms phantom. Clicking the phantom adds 30% bonus score without breaking combo.
mutation-t2-echo.name: Echo

mutation-t2-magnet.description: All interactive objects drift toward your cursor at ~18 px/s. Bombs included.
mutation-t2-magnet.name: Magnet

mutation-t2-phase-flash.description: Targets fade to 10% alpha for 150 ms every 700 ms. Clicking while invisible = ×2 score.
mutation-t2-phase-flash.name: Phase Flash

mutation-t3-mirror-spawn.description: Every target spawns with a mirrored twin. Clicking either destroys both; score awarded only for the clicked one.
mutation-t3-mirror-spawn.name: Mirror Spawn

mutation-t3-time-pulse.description: Every 6 s, 2 s of either ×0.6 or ×1.6 game speed. HUD warns 0.5 s before.
mutation-t3-time-pulse.name: Time Pulse

mutation-t4-bloom.description: Ultimate: 5 s where targets and bombs grow from 100% to 200% over their lifetime, current spawn rate doubles, and all scores ×2.
mutation-t4-bloom.name: Bloom

reaction.description: Easier targets, more time, calmer rhythm.
reaction.name: Reaction

reaction-t1-balanced.description: +10% lifetime and +8% size on every target.
reaction-t1-balanced.name: Balanced

reaction-t2-bomb-warning.description: Bombs blink twice as fast in their last second.
reaction-t2-bomb-warning.name: Bomb Warning

reaction-t2-pre-crack.description: Shielded targets lose their shield even on a missed click.
reaction-t2-pre-crack.name: Pre-Crack

reaction-t2-quick-multi.description: Multi targets only need 2 clicks instead of 3.
reaction-t2-quick-multi.name: Quick Multi

reaction-t3-slow-spawn.description: Spawn animation is 50% slower - you see targets sooner.
reaction-t3-slow-spawn.name: Slow Spawn

reaction-t4-time-slow.description: Ultimate: slow the world to half speed for 5 seconds.
reaction-t4-time-slow.name: Time Slow

survival-t1-extra-life.description: Start every run with one additional HP.
survival-t1-extra-life.name: Extra Life

survival-t1-soft-bombs.description: After the first bomb-click per run, further bomb-clicks cost no HP.
survival-t1-soft-bombs.name: Soft Bombs

survival-t1-warm-up.description: Your first missed target each run is forgiven.
survival-t1-warm-up.name: Warm-Up

survival-t2-open-field.description: Clicking the background no longer breaks combo.
survival-t2-open-field.name: Open Field

survival-t3-mercy.description: 1 second of invulnerability after taking damage.
survival-t3-mercy.name: Mercy

survival-t3-shield-forgiveness.description: A missed shielded target breaks your combo but costs no HP.
survival-t3-shield-forgiveness.name: Shield Forgiveness

survival-t4-restore.description: Ultimate: heal to full HP. Disables HP regen perks for the rest of the run.
survival-t4-restore.name: Restore

wild.description: Chaos rewards the bold and punishes the lazy.
wild.name: Wild

wild-t1-concentrated.description: Bomb spawn weight halved, but every 5th target is guaranteed a bomb.
wild-t1-concentrated.name: Concentrated

wild-t1-lucky-big.description: 5% chance a target spawns at 2× size and awards 2× score.
wild-t1-lucky-big.name: Lucky Big

wild-t1-volatile-time.description: Each target's lifetime varies randomly by ±50%.
wild-t1-volatile-time.name: Volatile Time

wild-t2-decoy-gold.description: 15% of bombs disguise themselves as golden targets.
wild-t2-decoy-gold.name: Decoy Gold

wild-t2-rush-pulse.description: Every 30 seconds, spawn rate triples for 5 seconds.
wild-t2-rush-pulse.name: Rush Pulse

wild-t3-cursor-magnet.description: Targets drift toward your cursor at ~25 px/s - stacks with mutation magnet.
wild-t3-cursor-magnet.name: Cursor Magnet

wild-t3-mortgage.description: All scores ×2 this run, but you earn no currency.
wild-t3-mortgage.name: Mortgage

wild-t4-chaos-storm.description: Ultimate: 4 seconds of ×4 spawn rate, fully randomized target types, glitch shader.
wild-t4-chaos-storm.name: Chaos Storm
